study: PhysX contact geometry and nonlinear tire laws for controlled high-speed sideslip
systems: original CARLA traj_4 source state trajectory
existing_frozen_reward_experiments: Preserve K/L/M and their exact results; new physics is a separately labeled cohort.
normal_contact: Native PhysX in every matched-law arm; same geometry, mass, inertia, collision settings, timestep and initial state.

force_law_arms.purpose: Measure external-force coupling/one-physical-step load-delay effects before attributing differences to tire nonlinearity.
Combined-slip sensitivity model using the open xcar curve shape; not identified real TRON1/CARLA tire parameters.

no_double_counting: External-law arms retain native normal contact but disable native tangential friction; apply tangential force and its COM moment to the wheel body only.

geometry_control.initial: Existing authored TRON1 cylinder radius0.127m width0.05m; inspect cooked geometry separately.
geometry_control.optional_later: Single-cylinder versus sliced-cylinder profile, at fixed force law; never conflate this geometry ablation with the tire-law ablation.

single_wheel_bench.fixture: Lock world X/Z angular motion only; wheel spin Y and XYZ translation remain free. This laboratory fixture does not alter the actual TRON1 task.
single_wheel_bench.initial_free_wheel_probe: Preserved as a toppling diagnostic, excluded from force-law comparison.

evaluation.first: Same initial state and identical wheel torques/steering or identical normalized robot actions; no per-step root prescription.
evaluation.second: Same frozen controller on each law measures transfer sensitivity, not controller optimality.
evaluation.later: Only after law bench passes, matched-budget controller adaptation or retraining under each law; no mixing frozen-policy transfer and retrained outcomes.
evaluation.views: Fixed-scale top view with body, wheel rolling-plane and velocity headings; retain raw physics clocks.

human_motion_prior_assessment.reusable_hypothesis: GMR-retargeted posture and support-transition priors may improve balance/load transfer while task rewards specify the drift path, speed and intended beta.
proposed_later_ablation: phase-aligned human-motion tracking plus same task
AMP motion prior plus same task
human_motion_prior_assessment.fairness: Same physical law, actor observations, driven-wheel actions, task reward, seed set and transition budget. AMP adds a training-only discriminator; wheel spin remains excluded from imitation targets.
human_motion_prior_assessment.required_data: Licensed motion clips with enough travel/turning; preserve actual speed and bilateral rolling-plane headings/contact annotations provenance. Straight gliding clips are not relabeled as drift demonstrations.
